events.description: Called when the back button is pressed; giving it draws the button.
events.name: onBack

props.description: What the screen is called, in a few words. Required: it is the heading a screen reader announces for the screen.
props.name: title

props.description: The title's place in the document outline, 1 to 6, on web. Defaults to 1; native has no levels and ignores it.
props.name: headingLevel

props.description: True to draw the title large under the bar, which then holds only the back button and the slots.
props.name: hasLargeTitle

props.description: Where the back button leads when it is a link; giving it draws the button, which also calls `onBack` first.
props.name: backHref

props.description: The accessible name of the back button. Defaults to `ui::navigation_header.back` in the active locale.
props.name: backLabel

props.description: The spoken name of the region, for example "Main navigation"; required when the page holds two of its kind.
props.name: label

props.description: A node at the logical start of the bar, before its main content.
props.name: startContent

props.description: A node at the logical end of the bar, after its main content.
props.name: endContent

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref
